Which type of car constituted 30% of all cars produced by the company during 2013?
solution:
**Given:**

Cars produced by the company during 2013 = 70

**Concept Used:**

Percentage Composition = Percentage of cars × Total cars

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total cars produced in 2013 = 70

⇒ Number of cars according to percentage composition in 2013 = 30% × 70

⇒ Number of cars according to percentage composition in 2013 = (30)/(100)×70=21

**∴ The type of car which constituted 30% of all cars produced during 2013 is D1.**
